nodes.label: Members Leaf Model Package
nodes.rationale: The leaf package avoids an import cycle with members/subcommands.

nodes.label: Required Verification Checks
nodes.rationale: The project requires compile, vet, format, and test checks after every code change before claiming completion.

nodes.label: Co-Located Living Specs
nodes.rationale: Living specs are kept beside feature modules so they describe the current post-change reality.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Platform Scope
nodes.rationale: Restricting the feature to currently hardcoded platforms prevents custom platform creation.

nodes.label: Table-Like Embed Format
nodes.rationale: The structured field layout is optimized for scanning.

nodes.label: Deterministic Platform Ordering
nodes.rationale: Stable ordering supports quick visual comparison across show responses.

nodes.label: Partial Upstream Failure Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Available exchange-rate data remains useful when one currency source is unavailable.

nodes.label: Source and Freshness Transparency
nodes.rationale: Displayed currency data must expose its source and update time.
